verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents its own IAM predefined roles and granular permissions scoped to datasets, tables, views, and routines, so access for an agent's identity can be limited to least privilege. However, the pack has no evidence of how credentials themselves are issued: no service-account or key creation, no agent-specific tokens, and no expiry or rotation. That issuance mechanism belongs to the host Google Cloud platform rather than to BigQuery, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented credential issuance (service accounts, keys, short-lived tokens), agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of least-privilege setups.
